content: SignalWorks is the fictional operations data plane for Fabrikam Consumer Products (synthetic demo). It gives plant events, quality results and maintenance records common identifiers, then packages approved features and monitoring rules for reuse. A model is promoted to another line only after local calibration, operator review and drift thresholds are recorded.
title: SignalWorks operations data plane

content: The synthetic demand model uses shipment and point-of-sale history, promotion timing, distribution changes, weather and category seasonality. Forecast-value-added checks compare each adjustment with a baseline. The approved forecast feeds S&OP and inventory targets, while unusually large lifts require reconciliation with the trade plan.
title: Demand forecast input controls

content: A fictional LittleSteps line uses a vision signal to recommend adhesive set-point changes inside qualified bounds. Operators approve exceptions, bond-integrity tests remain the release criterion, and each change is logged by lot and line. The objective is lower material use without trading away seam strength or quality control.
title: LittleSteps adhesive control runbook

content: Safety stock is set by item from demand variability, replenishment lead time, service target and material criticality. Promotion packs and high runners use separate policies. Planners recalculate buffers only after measuring whether demand sensing reduced short-term error, protecting availability while avoiding unsupported working-capital claims.
title: Inventory policy and safety stock

content: The synthetic network moves finished cases through plants, regional distribution centers and retailer nodes. Carrier scorecards combine OTIF or on-time-in-full, damage, cost and emissions. Route consolidation and backhauls target empty miles; disruption playbooks allow a mode or node change only after service and inventory impacts are compared.
title: Distribution service and carrier scorecards

content: Overall Equipment Effectiveness is calculated as Availability multiplied by Performance multiplied by Quality. The daily review separates planned changeover, micro-stop, speed and defect losses. Sequencing and quick-change methods address availability; condition checks address recurring stops; every action has a baseline and post-change OEE measure.
title: OEE loss and changeover method

content: Line sensors produce fictional vibration, temperature and web-tension features. An anomaly alert is checked against recent setup changes, inspection history and known failure modes before maintenance is scheduled. Technicians log the finding and intervention so avoided downtime can be compared with false alerts rather than assumed.
title: Predictive maintenance decision runbook

content: The demo SAP landscape retains governed material, order, inventory, capacity and finance concepts. Read-only integrations expose object IDs, authorization scope, retrieval time and fixture status. Reconciliation jobs compare analytical extracts with source totals, and disaster-recovery exercises verify that planning can resume from an approved recovery point.
title: SAP operational data controls

content: The monthly S&OP cycle reconciles a statistical demand view with launch, promotion and customer assumptions, then compares it with capacity, inventory and financial targets. Decisions record the scenario, owner and due date. Material gaps and service risks are escalated rather than hidden inside a consensus number.
title: Synthetic S&OP decision cycle

content: The supplier scorecard covers financial health, geographic concentration, single-source dependency, quality history, compliance and available capacity. A critical rating triggers evidence-based mitigation: qualify alternates, reserve capacity, redesign the specification or hold a time-bounded buffer. Every action names an owner and review date.
title: Supplier risk and alternate-source method

content: The fictional Adaptive Supply Network blends a baseline with recent point-of-sale, e-commerce, inventory, promotion and weather signals. Backtests gate each signal before production use. The operating target is lower forecast error with fewer stockouts and less excess inventory, measured separately by item and horizon.
title: Adaptive Supply Network demand sensing

content: Synthetic sourcing controls require traceable palm-derived inputs, FSC-certified or controlled fiber and documented recycled-resin claims. Purchase records retain certificate scope, supplier site and chain-of-custody evidence. Exceptions enter a grievance and remediation workflow; an unsupported certificate is not treated as compliant supply.
title: Responsible material chain of custody
